svg.title: The public API of Kalman
svg.desc: The public API of the fcarouge namespace. Named arguments configure the kalman class template, whose filter type is deduced at compile time, and policies select its update form and its conditioning. The class exposes conditional member types, the characteristics x, z, u, p, q, r, f, h, g, k, y, and s, each read, set, or replaced by a callable, and the predict and update modifiers. The print decorator inherits and decorates a filter, a standard formatter specialization formats it, and a user supplied linear algebra backend provides the matrix types beyond scalar filters.
